host.description: Host name of the identity provider, like sso.example.org

lets_encrypt.description: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name

restrict_admin_console.description: Allow the Keycloak admin console from the node only

directory_groups_only.description: Ignore local Keycloak group memberships. Required by client access policies

account_home_redirect.description: Lead the host root to the account console instead of the admin console

strict_client_uris.description: Accept only exact HTTPS or native client endpoints at client registration
